title: Astut card
description: One card in the bank: what it asks, what it answers, and the one move it trains. The field names match lib/data/card_json.dart; check.py enforces what a schema cannot say.

id.description: Topic key, a dash, then anything unique. Never reused, even for a retired card.

kind.description: read: turn it over. pickOne: commit to an option. number: work out an exact number. estimate: a Fermi estimate, judged within a factor. debate: take a side, then meet the other one; never graded.

principle.description: What the card is an instance of. Every graded card has one; a read and a debate have none.

answer.description: The reveal. On a number or estimate card it is the last line of the steps.

move.description: The one line that survives the card.

trap.description: The wrong answer most people reach for first, and why it feels right.

hint.description: A way in, without the number.

steps.description: The worked solution, one move per line.

simply.description: A second way in: a concrete image, not the same words made smaller.

counterpoint.description: On a debate, the strongest case against whichever side was taken.

source.description: The short label the reader sees: institution and document, or the name of the result.

reference.description: Where the claim can be checked: a URL, a DOI, or a book and page. Required on every generated card.

written.description: The day the card was generated.

disabled.description: Retired: never dealt again, still opens in a deck that already holds it.
